ov: مارلي وأنا (الإنجليزية: Marley & Me) فيلم أمريكي تم إنتاجه سنة 2008.
plotEn:
After newlyweds John and Jenny Grogan relocate from Michigan to South Florida, they obtain reporter jobs at rival newspaper firms. At The Palm Beach Post, Jenny immediately receives prominent front-page assignments, while at the South Florida Sun-Sentinel, John finds himself writing obituaries and mundane two-paragraph news articles.
When John senses Jenny is contemplating motherhood, his friend and co-worker, Sebastian Tunney, suggests adopting a dog to test their readiness to have a baby. They choose a yellow Labrador Retriever puppy that John names Marley (after hearing a  Bob Marley song on the radio).
A year later, Marley, now weighing about 100 pounds, proves to be incorrigible, forcing John and Jenny to enroll him in a dog obedience class. The unruly dog is expelled, and the decision is made to have Marley neutered.
Editor Arnie Klein offers John a twice-weekly column writing about anything he likes. Initially stumped for ideas, John realizes that Marley's misadventures might be the perfect topic for his first column. Arnie loves it, and Marley's continual wreaking havoc on the household provides John with endless sources of material. The column's popularity eventually helps double the paper's circulation.
